newsitem.title: UK: DTI to approve BA-American Airlines link - paper.
newsitem.headline: DTI to approve BA-American Airlines link - paper.

text.p: The UK Department of Trade and Industry is expected to give the green light to the proposed transatlantic link between British Airways and American Airlines next month, according to a report in The Independent on Wednesday.
The report said DTI chief Ian Lang would announce his decision in a fortnight after receiving comments from competition watchdog The Office of Fair Trading three weeks ago.
The Independent report was based on unnamed industry sources.
It added that the DTI was expected to time its decision to help clear the way for British and U.S. government negotiators to hammer out an "open skies" deal.
